t: What Does The Name Takira Mean?
s: Takira is most commonly understood as a modern, phonetic variant of the Japanese feminine name Takara, meaning “treasure; precious,” and it is often associated with the verb takeru/takeru in older forms meaning “to be strong/brave,” giving the name an aura of value and vitality.
